cause_quote: The new agent registry load plan passed `...(plan.config ? { activationSourceConfig: plan.config } : {})`, supplying the prepared config as the authored source.
user_saw: An agent plugin could fail to load with an invalid-config error even though its configured SecretRef was valid.
summary: Agent plugin loading now validates the authored SecretRef from the captured config generation and passes the resolved credential to the plugin.
reasoning: The scoped agent loader shipped with an explicit source override pointing to prepared values. The shared loader later added authored SecretRef validation in #131310, but its source resolver still honored that override, and #135118 carried the same assignment forward. I found no version of the affected agent load plan that preserved the authored SecretRef before this fix.
